item.text:
Send this to one former colleague who knows your work:

> “I’m looking for contract work solving a specific business problem—not an open-ended advisory role. What’s one problem you’d trust me to take off your team’s plate? If something comes to mind, I’d be happy to outline a small paid first step.”

Their answer can give you both a credible offer idea and a potential lead—without building a website or posting content.
